overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board's account that a recording notice was read at the May 26 meeting, but not captured on video, was credited over the complaint.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the chair did not announce at the start of the May 26 meeting that it was being recorded, as the law requires.
allegations.key_passage: Absent evidence to the contrary, we credit the Board’s version of events and find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law as alleged.
